title: Semiconductor Supply Chain Visibility
thesis: Snowflake builds the supply chain graph natively — every BOM level, supplier risk, and lead time tracked in Dynamic Tables, exported as Iceberg for partner self-service

talking_points: RM 890 million in annual procurement across 50 tier-1 suppliers in the Penang-Kulim semiconductor corridor.
Three suppliers flagged HIGH RISK — delivery failures, financial instability, and single-source concentration.
Average lead time deviation is 12 days — four suppliers consistently breaching SLA.
show: Highlight 3 HIGH RISK suppliers in red
tabs.call_out: 3 suppliers HIGH RISK — RM 890M procurement at stake

transition.line: Let's drill into the BOM to understand where concentration risk lives.

talking_points: 2,000 BOM items tracked across 5 product families — multi-level parent-child relationships.
7 critical components have single-source dependency — no qualified alternative supplier.
BOM cost variance trending up 8.3% quarter-over-quarter due to rare earth price escalation.
show: Point at cost variance trend chart
tabs.call_out: 7 critical components with zero alternative — single point of failure

transition.line: Now let's look at what ML tells us about future disruptions.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST predicts lead time for each supplier 30 days forward — two suppliers trending toward SLA breach.
ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION flagged unusual delivery patterns from 4 suppliers in the last 21 days.
Supplier S-017 (silicon wafer raw material) shows 92% probability of 3-week delay next month.
show: Show lead time forecast chart with confidence bands
tabs.call_out: S-017 silicon wafer supplier — 92% probability of 3-week delay

transition.line: Let the CSCO ask the system directly about mitigation options.

talking_points: Lim Chee Keong asks: 'Which suppliers have the highest risk of disruption next quarter?'
Cortex Analyst queries the supply graph, returns ranked risk scores with reasoning.
Switch to advisor: 'What are our options if S-017 fails to deliver?' — searches contracts and recommends alternatives.
show: Type: 'Which suppliers are at highest risk next quarter?'
Switch to advisor mode for mitigation
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: supply chain analytics + strategic advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, open Iceberg for partners.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services — Iceberg as the interoperability layer.
Partners query supply chain data via Athena on Iceberg — no data copies, no ETL pipelines.
Malaysia's semiconductor exports: RM 450 billion. This tracks 50 suppliers, 2,000 BOM items, 10,000 POs.
tabs.call_out: One platform, Iceberg for partners, native supply chain graph

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — supply chain visibility for semiconductor manufacturing.
